clue.text: What helps one remember to snatch a rest

indicators.note: the memory aid grabs the letter and holds it within itself

parts.note: a reminder is a prompt that jogs the memory

explanation.surface: A memory aid that makes sure you grab a quick break.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rest' here is the leftover part, not a nap; 'to snatch' is the containment signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: the rest of something is what is left over.

clue.text: Character to go round in circles, we hear

indicators.note: signals that the word for rolling is spoken, giving a word of the same sound

parts.note: to roll is to turn over and over, going round and round

explanation.surface: Someone whose personality seems to keep them going round in circles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'we hear' means the answer sounds like ROLL.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: an actor's character in a play is the part they take.

clue.text: Name inscribed in a medal, prepared for old statesman

indicators.note: the letter is written within the words a medal, like an engraving
the letters are worked up into a new form

explanation.surface: A name engraved on a medal made ready for a former statesman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inscribed in' puts N into A MEDAL; 'prepared' rearranges AMEDALN.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Nelson Mandela was South Africa's first black president, a statesman who died in 2013.

clue.text: Artificial language I study

parts.note: to do a subject is to study it, as in doing history at university

explanation.surface: Someone saying they study a constructed language.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Ido is a constructed international language derived from Esperanto.

clue.text: Give university lecturer freshly made tea

parts.note: a don is a teacher at a university, especially Oxford or Cambridge

indicators.note: the letters of tea are made up anew in a different order

explanation.surface: Offering a college teacher a newly brewed cuppa.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to give money or goods to a cause is to donate them.

clue.text: A doctrine rewritten in new edition

indicators.note: the letters of the phrase are written out again in another order

explanation.surface: A body of teaching revised for a fresh printing.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a redaction is an edited or revised version of a text.

clue.text: Unhappy workers finally given notice

indicators.note: points to the closing letter of the word workers

parts.note: an ad is a notice, an advertisement

explanation.surface: Staff are miserable after being given notice of dismissal.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: someone sad is unhappy.

clue.text: Not moving yet

definitions.meaning: even so, nevertheless, as in '..., it was worth it'

explanation.surface: Not moving yet.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: motionless, and an adverb meaning nevertheless or up to now.

clue.text: Times in which one gets some sort of railway hold-ups

indicators.note: the railway letters are placed within the word for times

parts.note: days are times, as in 'in my days'
EL is short for an elevated railway, as in Chicago

explanation.surface: Periods when train travellers suffer hold-ups.
explanation.walkthrough: The railway is the American elevated kind, as in Chicago; 'in which one gets' signals the container.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: delays are hold-ups that make things late.

clue.text: See someone who was once President

definitions.meaning: a see is a bishop's diocese, and ... is a cathedral city with one
Abraham ... was the sixteenth US President

explanation.surface: An invitation to look at a former head of state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See' looks like an instruction; it is the noun for a bishop's seat.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: an English cathedral city's diocese, and Abraham, the American leader.

clue.text: Make a hole in fabric

definitions.meaning: to bore through something with a rotating tool

explanation.surface: Pierce a piece of cloth.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: boring with a tool, and a hard-wearing twilled cotton cloth.

clue.text: Local types I'd ordered around like a tyrant

indicators.note: the letters are arranged and pushed around into a fresh sequence

explanation.surface: Someone bossing the locals around in a tyrannical manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a despot is a tyrant, so acting despotically is behaving tyrannically.

clue.text: Pagan god astride unusual throne in temple

indicators.note: the god's name straddles the other letters, one part each side

parts.note: Pan is the Greek god of shepherds and the wild

indicators.note: the letters of throne come out in an unusual arrangement

explanation.surface: A heathen deity sits on a strange seat in a shrine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unusual' is the anagram signal and 'astride' the container: the god straddles the jumbled seat.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the Parthenon is the temple of Athena on the Athens Acropolis.

clue.text: Father meets Irish couple

parts.note: pa is an informal word for father

explanation.surface: A dad meets a married Irish twosome.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a pair is two of something, a couple.

clue.text: Distance achieved by bird, heading off

indicators.note: the first letter, the head, of the bird is taken away

parts.note: a finch is a small songbird

explanation.surface: How far a bird flew when it set off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading off' sounds like a bird departing; it removes F from FINCH.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: an imperial unit of length, about two and a half centimetres.

clue.text: Gossips outside the French holiday accommodation

indicators.note: the gossip word sits round the French article

parts.note: to chat is to gossip
le is French for the

explanation.surface: Chattering people outside a French holiday home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside' is the container signal, wrapping the gossip word round the French article.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: chalets are wooden huts let to holidaymakers, as at ski resorts or holiday camps.

clue.text: Brought low and embarrassed? Not hard

indicators.note: says the letter for hard is missing from the word

parts.note: abashed means embarrassed or disconcerted
H is the pencil abbreviation for hard

explanation.surface: Someone humiliated and embarrassed, though it was not hard on them.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: to be abased is to be humbled or degraded.

clue.text: Work set up around a king in Polish city

indicators.note: the reversed word goes round the other letters
in a down clue, set up means the word is written upwards, so read backwards

parts.note: K is the chess abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: Labour organised around a monarch in a Polish city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set up' turns WORK into KROW; 'around' puts it round AK.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Krakow is Poland's old royal capital in the south of the country.

clue.text: Lib ranter who upset one of the extended family

indicators.note: the letters are knocked over into a new order

explanation.surface: A ranting Liberal Democrat who annoyed a relative.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a sister's husband or spouse's male sibling, related by marriage.

clue.text: Old person showing wisdom, native American

parts.note: a sage is a wise person

explanation.surface: An elderly wise Native American.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: the Osage are a Native American people of the Great Plains.

clue.text: Lacking skill is party game for children

indicators.note: means the words is party are without the letters for skill

parts.note: art is skill, as in the art of conversation

explanation.surface: A clumsy party game played by children.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lacking skill' looks like a description of a person; it removes ART from ISPARTY.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: a children's guessing game played by saying 'something beginning with...'

clue.text: Country home to the east of health centre

indicators.note: in an across clue, east is to the right, so the home word comes after

parts.note: a spa is a resort with health treatments
in means at home

explanation.surface: A rural home just east of a health resort.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: Spain is a country in south-west Europe.

clue.text: Numbers attached to equipment for small pets

indicators.note: the numbers are joined on after the equipment

parts.note: kit is gear or equipment
tens are numbers

explanation.surface: Tags with numbers on kit for little animals.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: young cats are kept as small household pets.

clue.text: Period in which maiden's removed link

indicators.note: the maiden letter is taken out of the word

parts.note: a time is a period
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: An era when a young woman's connection was cut.
explanation.walkthrough: A maiden in cricket is an over with no runs scored, written M on scorecards.
explanation.definitionFit: Synonym: a tie is a bond or connection.

clue.text: Something spotted in a game of chance?

definitions.text: Something spotted in a game of chance?

parts.words: Something spotted in a game of chance?
parts.note: looks like something noticed while gambling, but it is a cube marked with spots that is thrown

explanation.surface: Something noticed during a gamble.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spotted' means seen on the surface but literally covered in spots.
explanation.definitionFit: Example: one of a pair of dice, a spotted cube used in games of chance.

clue.text: State requirement for one with hole in jumper?

definitions.meaning: a state of the USA on the east coast

definitions.text: requirement for one with hole in jumper?
definitions.meaning: someone whose sweater is holed needs a fresh one

explanation.surface: What is needed when your sweater has a hole.
explanation.walkthrough: A jersey is a jumper, a knitted sweater; a holed one needs replacing.
explanation.definitionFit: Two senses: the US state, and a fresh replacement sweater.
